In app/models/topic_embed.rb, `import` immediately returns `nil` unless the url matches `^https?://`, so a feed item with both invalid `link` and invalid/non-http(s) `id` will be silently skipped (no logging/explicit next). That’s an untested edge-case: spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb only tests gating conditions and never exercises items with invalid link/id to validate the fallback/skip behavior.
